messages:
IncidentBot: P1 alert — high error rate on /v1/generate for customer accounts routed to eu-west-1. Error pattern: 500 / incompatible-variant. Paging oncall Clara.
Clara (sre-oncall): seeing spikes, 10x errors from a subset of customers. Traces show model routing chose an 'embeddings' variant for chat requests. This looks like a pinned model version that doesn't support the chat generation path.
Diego (eng-runtime): confirmed — policy eval logs show a pin to model 'redwood-open-7b@v2026-02-11' which is an instruct-only variant. SmartRouting fallback picked the nearest compatible variant but the variant is incompatible for chat API calls and returns 500.
Priya (product-sre): @Clara what's the customer impact? Which tenants are affected?
Clara (sre-oncall): impact concentrated on two enterprise tenants in eu-west-1 (acct: AcmeCorp, acct: NovaPay). Approx 18% of requests are failing for those customers, latency for others unaffected. Support tickets incoming.
Jason (support): Maya flagged a production ticket from NovaPay. They're seeing intermittent failures in their realtime chat flow. They're asking if this is on our side.
Maya (sales-ops): FYI NovaPay is on a committed Dedicated plan. Need estimate for time-to-fix and whether to offer workaround.
Diego (eng-runtime): quick root cause: a user config change yesterday pinned a model *version* that is a different model family (instruction-tuned) for a route that expects chat-capable model. Our fallback policy allowed variant substitution by version only, but we failed to check capability flags (chat vs instruct vs embed) before selecting fallback.
Clara (sre-oncall): mitigation options?
Diego (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations:
- hotfix routing rule to prefer same "capabilities" tag when selecting fallback (manual override) — low risk, can push in ~20m.
- unpin the customer route temporarily to let default routing pick a chat-capable model — needs config change, low-risk, instant.
- temporary proxy that maps chat endpoints to a stable chat-capable variant for those tenant ids — more invasive.
Priya (product-sre): recommend unpin for the two affected tenants now, then push the hotfix to prevent recurrence.
Clara (sre-oncall): I can do the unpin now. Executing config change: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/routes/unpin -d '{"tenant":"AcmeCorp"}'` (redacted).
deploy-bot: config change accepted, route unpinned for AcmeCorp by Clara — job 8421 started.
Clara (sre-oncall): unpinned NovaPay as well.
deploy-bot: config change accepted, route unpinned for NovaPay by Clara — job 8422 started.
Diego (eng-runtime): monitoring... errors dropping from 18% to ~1.5% for those tenants. Looks like immediate impact mitigated. Sending patch PR for routing capability check: `# PR 3245`.
Clara (sre-oncall): good. Keep monitoring for 30m. @Jason prioritize customer comms that we unpinned a mis-specified route and are rolling a safety fix.
Jason (support): on it. Drafting note: "We've identified a pinned model version mismatch causing chat requests to be routed to an instruction-only variant. We've unpinned your route to restore service and are deploying a safety fix to prevent this in future. ETA for permanent fix ~2 hours." Want approvals?
Maya (sales-ops): fine to send that. Offer to help coordinate follow-up call with account team.
Diego (eng-runtime): PR merged to staging with tests. Hotfix roll described in PR: check 'capabilities' label during fallback selection and deny fallback if capability mismatch. Rolling canary to eu-west-1 now.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: rollout 10% eu-west-1 — task 9921.
Clara (sre-oncall): errors trending down to baseline. No other regions affected. Recording incident for postmortem: missing capability validation in fallback routing + lack of pre-deploy guardrail on pinned-version changes.
Priya (product-sre): I'll own the postmortem and follow-up action items: 1) add capability checks in routing policy matrix, 2) prevent cross-family pinning without console warning, 3) update runbook for rapid unpin.
Jason (support): customer notifications sent to NovaPay and AcmeCorp. They requested a short RCA once done.
Diego (eng-runtime): after canary looks good, deploying global rollout in 15m.
deploy-bot: rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% complete. Rollout complete.
Clara (sre-oncall): closing page if no further regressions. Leaving thread open for RCA notes and timeline.
Priya (product-sre): tagging for postmortem: impact: two enterprise tenants, partial outage for chat generation, mitigation: unpin + hotfix, time-to-recovery: ~18 minutes from page to unpin. Next steps: schedule follow-up with account team and patch console UX to warn on incompatible pins.
Diego (eng-runtime): adding a quick query we used to find affected routes:
```
SELECT tenant_id, route_id, pinned_model, capability_tag
FROM routing_state
WHERE pinned_model IS NOT NULL
  AND capability_tag != expected_capability('route')
```
Clara (sre-oncall): saving that. Thanks team. I'll update incident channel and mark P1 -> resolved monitor for 1hr.
IncidentBot: Incident P1 resolved — mitigation confirmed. Add postmortem link when available."
